name: Tooltip
looksLike: small text label that appears when I hover
hint that appears when a button gets focus
definition: A short, non-interactive hint shown beside a control on hover or keyboard focus.
whenToUse: Providing optional context for a control

notConfusedWith.difference: Can contain richer content and interactive controls; a tooltip contains only a short hint.

prompts.short: Add a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Dismiss it with Escape.
prompts.detailed: Add a short tooltip that opens on hover and focus, remains available while hovered, and closes on Escape. Associate it with its trigger, keep focus on the trigger, and include no interactive content. Keep essential instructions visible outside the tooltip.
